subject: English
passage: In a field guide entry on the coqui frog, ecologists Mohan Bose and Zahra Sow note that audio recordings of the species don't lose their ______ character when played back: the calls have the same pleasant musical quality through speakers as they do when heard in the rainforest at dusk.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The passage states that the recordings have the same 'pleasant musical quality' as the live calls. 'Melodic' precisely captures this idea of a pleasing, musical sound.
